description: agent.create can give a new agent more than a name: the instructions it runs with (`prompt`), the technologies it works in (`tech`, from the closed vocabulary handlers.list offers), the tools it may ask for (`tools`, registered tool names) the colour of its minion (`avatarColor`, a colour word or #rrggbb) and which minion it is (`avatarMinion`: pip, bop or noodle, kept in the metadata under `minion`), and what it must report when it finishes (`handoff`: field name to purpose, a trailing ? on the name marking the field optional; checked the way the runtime reads it). Every part but the name is optional, so a caller that sends a name alone gets what it always did. A tag or a tool nobody compiled is refused by name, never dropped. The result is the created row.
